admission.justification: A future reviewer change must not introduce a second judgment store/retention job that can diverge from authoritative leaf histories.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer retained-history boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: Judgment is read from the selected after-memory Git tree, scoped to this leaf and all its attempt histories; unreadable history remains unavailable.
exclusions: No independent assessment-retention service, repository garbage-collection guarantee, archival lifetime measurement or fresh execution.
statement: Judgments are history files retained in Git and need no second assessment-retention channel.
